newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 234 FOR TWO AT LUNCH V WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA 234 FOR TWO AT LUNCH V WEST INDIES.

text.p: Australia were 234 for two at lunch on the second day of their fourth test match against West Indies at the Adelaide Oval on Sunday.
Australia - 234 for two from 67 overs (Overnight 139 for two) - (Matthew Hayden 105 not out, Mark Waugh 76 not out).
West Indies first innings - 130 in 47.5 overs (Michael Bevan four for 31, Shane Warne three for 42.)
